findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_stock" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_today, get_data_urls, get_disclosure_impact · Private data: get_data_urls, get_history, get_disclosure_impact · Public sink: search_stock, get_earnings_calendar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_today, get_data_urls, get_disclosure_impact · Private data: get_data_urls, get_history, get_disclosure_impact · Public sink: search_stock, get_earnings_calendar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
